title: Nyeu Tih Sung

page_data.en:
Referred to Commandant, S.V.C. for information.
C. I. D.
No. 269
Date 21/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 19th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
（批：269 12/4 16）
（左侧竖排印章文字：CENTRAL REGISTRY When finished with...）

Sir,
It is reported that the rebel leader Nyeu Tih Sung钮铁生 is recruiting in Minghong and is being assisted by one Sung Pao Nyi沈宝义 alias Sung Siau Me沈小梅 Chief of the Salt Smuggling Prevention Force in that place.
The rebels are trying to induce the Woosung garrison to join them but have been unsuccessful so far.
It is reported in rebel circles that Kiangyin will send troops to attack Woosung.
With reference to the report of 16th instant regarding a Chapel Police Inspector who absconded from his post, it is now said that he received $20,000 from the rebels to buy over the Chapel Police but instead of doing so, ran away with the money.
It is reported that there is considerable difference of opinion among the rebels here who are breaking up into several parties. Nyeu Tih Sung has sent a letter to all leaders exhorting them to remain united and not to take any action until they receive orders from the proper authority.
It is reported that Kading will soon declare independence.
It is reported that two young Chinese dressed in foreign clothes were arrested by the Arsenal authorities on 17th instant in possession of bombs and pistols.
It is reported that five hundred soldiers arrived from Nanking in Wusieh on 18th instant.
Fourteen boxes of ammunition were sent to Sungkiang from the Arsenal yesterday afternoon by the Shanghai Hangchow Railway.
It is reported that Tang Shao Yi and Wu Ting Fang have been telegraphically requested by Yuan Shih Kai to proceed to Peking and assist in forming the national assembly.
It is reported that the pistols which were handed to the rebels on 17th instant have not all been returned to the rebel headquarters. The leaders are making an effort to get them.

转交上海义勇队指挥官知悉。
刑事侦缉处
第269号
日期 1916年4月21日
上海工部局。
1916年4月19日。

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
（批：269 16年4月12日）
（左侧竖排印章文字：中央登记处 处理完毕后...）

先生，
据报，叛军首领钮铁生正在闵行招募人员，并得到当地盐务缉私队队长沈宝义（别名沈小梅）的协助。
叛军正试图诱使吴淞驻军加入他们，但迄今未获成功。
据叛军方面消息，江阴将派兵进攻吴淞。
关于本月16日有关一名巡捕房督察员擅离职守的报告，现称该员从叛军处收受20,000美元以收买巡捕房人员，但他并未照办，而是携款潜逃。
据报，此地的叛军内部意见分歧严重，正分裂为数个派系。钮铁生已致信所有首领，劝诫他们保持团结，在收到上级命令前不得采取任何行动。
据报，嘉定即将宣布独立。
据报，两名身着西式服装的年轻华人于本月17日被兵工厂当局逮捕，当时他们持有炸弹和手枪。
据报，五百名士兵于本月18日从南京抵达吴淞。
昨日下午，十四箱弹药经沪杭铁路从兵工厂运往松江。
据报，袁世凯已电请唐绍仪和伍廷芳前往北京，协助组建国会。
据报，本月17日交给叛军的手枪并未全部归还至叛军总部。各首领正努力收回这些手枪。

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 269
Date 20/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
191

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

(2)

About 8.45 p.m. 18th instant a bomb explosion
took place near the Ningpo Guild in Frenchtown.
The explosion occurred on the street, nobody was
injured.
On the morning of April 18th a coolie in the
employ of the French P.W.D. working on the Yang King
Pang Road discovered a bomb which he struck with
his pick causing it to explode. He was taken to
Hospital suffering from injuries to his face and hands.
The bomb shell is similar in size and appearance to that
of the bomb which exploded on the night of April 17th
in Pah Sien Jao district killing the person who
was handling it.

Your Obedient Servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. apl 19

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记室
第269号
日期 1916年4月20日
上海工部局。
191

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

(2)

本月18日晚8时45分左右，法租界宁波同乡会附近发生了一起炸弹爆炸事件。
爆炸发生在街道上，无人受伤。
4月18日上午，一名受雇于法国公共工程局、在杨泾浜路工作的苦力发现了一枚炸弹，他用镐头击打炸弹导致其爆炸。他因面部和手部受伤被送往医院。
该炸弹弹壳的大小和外观与4月17日晚在八仙桥地区爆炸并炸死操作者的那枚炸弹相似。

您忠实的仆人，

[签名]

总探长。

警务处总监。

录入于警务处日志 4月19日
